description: This file defines a class ContactsJjwg_MapsLogicHook that hooks into contact-related events to update geocode information using the JJWG Maps module in SugarCRM.

classes.name: ContactsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A logic hook class for integrating JJWG Maps with contact records, updating geocode info on save events.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the hook class by retrieving module info for jjwg_Maps.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Executed before saving a contact; triggers geocode info update if enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Executed after saving a contact; updates geocode info for related meetings if enabled.
